newsitem.title: FRANCE: Pechiney sells European, U.S. assets.
newsitem.headline: Pechiney sells European, U.S. assets.

text.p: Pechiney said on Tuesday it planned to sell its caps and overcaps business in Europe and its carbon steel products distribution activity in the United States.
In a statement Pechiney said it had agreed to sell to British group H. Erben Ltd the caps and overcaps business of Pechiney Food Packaging for an undisclosed amount.
Caps products, used mainly for wines, champagnes and spirits, generate annual sales of 330 million francs. The
Pechiney also said it had agreed to sell to Canadian company Philip Environmental the U.S-based Intsel Southwest Limited Partnership for an undisclosed amount.
Intsel specialises in the distribution of carbon steel products for the construction, public works, and industrial equipment markets and makes annual sales of 660 million francs.
The transaction is expected to be finalised by end December.
